environment.hardware: MacBook Pro Mac15,3, Apple M3, 8 GB memory
environment.viewport: not separately recorded for this manual session

steps: Reload the accessibility harness and wait for the persisted medium Project.
Without clicking page content, traverse forward with the physical Tab key.
Confirm visible focus and order across the home link, import control, six viewer buttons, and pattern Canvas.
Enable VoiceOver and repeat the physical Tab traversal.
Confirm spoken names and roles for the link, import control, zoom controls, pan controls, and Canvas.
On the focused Canvas, use ArrowRight and Plus.
Select a visible stitch with the pointer and wait for persistence.
Confirm the selected-stitch and save-state announcements.

methodCorrection.initialAttempt: After clicking the Stitches 100,000 summary in the middle of the document, Tab and Option+Tab started at Zoom out.
methodCorrection.disposition: Rejected as a full-document traversal because the click established the sequential-focus starting point after the header controls.
methodCorrection.correction: Reload the page and begin physical Tab traversal without clicking page content.
methodCorrection.claimBoundary: The rejected attempt is not represented as an implementation failure or a passing full-document traversal.

physicalTabTraversal.ownerConfirmation: The corrected physical Tab traversal matched the expected order.

voiceOverTraversal.ownerConfirmation: VoiceOver announced every expected item and interaction exactly as described.
confirmedOutput: Home link name and link role
Import control name and button role
Canvas pattern name, 512 by 256 grid summary, 100000-stitch count, and keyboard instructions
Selected stitch coordinate, symbol, color, and marked or unmarked state

limitations: The VoiceOver version, exact viewport, and audio output were not independently captured.
The result is manual Project Owner confirmation, not automated screen-reader telemetry.
The evidence applies only to the recorded Chrome and macOS profile.
Firefox, Safari or WebKit, mobile, touch, forced-colors, and browser-zoom behavior remain unclaimed.
No product acceptance, release readiness, deployment authorization, Completion Report approval, or project VERIFIED status is assigned.
